name: Marie Biscuit
ingredients_raw: Wheat flour (atta 64.8%), sugar, refined vegetable oil (palm), malt extract, invert syrup, raising agents [INS 500(ii), INS 503(ii)], barley flour, milk solids, liquid glucose, honey, iodized salt, nature identical & artificial flavouring substances (vanilla), clarified butter, dough conditioner (INS 223), antioxidant (INS 319), emulsifier INS 322(i), natural colour (INS 150d).
